The controller should manage the requests and grants for each channel and provide a means to initiate transfers.

module dma_controller (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input req1,        // Request from channel 1
    input req2,        // Request from channel 2
    output reg gnt1,   // Grant to channel 1
    output reg gnt2,   // Grant to channel 2
    input [7:0] addr1, // Address for channel 1
    input [7:0] addr2, // Address for channel 2
    input [15:0] data_in1, // Data input for channel 1
    input [15:0] data_in2, // Data input for channel 2
    output reg [15:0] data_out1, // Data output for channel 1
    output reg [15:0] data_out2 // Data output for channel 2
);

    reg [1:0] state; // State machine state
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00,
               CH1_TRANSFER = 2'b01,
               CH2_TRANSFER = 2'b10;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            gnt1 <= 0;
            gnt2 <= 0;
            data_out1 <= 0;
            data_out2 <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    gnt1 <= 0;
                    gnt2 <= 0;
                    if (req1) begin
                        gnt1 <= 1;
                        state <= CH1_TRANSFER;
                    end else if (req2) begin
                        gnt2 <= 1;
                        state <= CH2_TRANSFER;
                    end
                end
                CH1_TRANSFER: begin
                    data_out1 <= data_in1; // Transfer data for channel 1
                    gnt1 <= 0; // Release grant
                    state <= IDLE; // Go back to idle
                end
                CH2_TRANSFER: begin
                    data_out2 <= data_in2; // Transfer data for channel 2
                    gnt2 <= 0; // Release grant
                    state <= IDLE; // Go back to idle
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

);

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        zero_cross <= 0;
        prev_signal <= 0;

        if ((prev_signal == 1 && signal == 0) || (prev_signal == 0 && signal == 1)) begin

    input wire start,

    input wire [7:0] data_in,

    output reg [7:0] data_out
);

              START = 4'b0001,
              SEND_DATA = 4'b0010,

            IDLE: begin
                sda <= 1;   // Idle state, SDA high
                scl <= 1;   // Idle state, SCL high
                ack <= 0;   // No ACK
                if (start) begin
                    state <= START;

                bit_count <= 0;

    input wire rst,
    input wire start,
    input wire [7:0] data_in,

    output reg mosi,
    output reg sclk,
    output reg cs,
    output reg [7:0] data_out,
    output reg done
);

    reg [7:0] shift_reg;
    reg sending;

            mosi <= 1'b0;
            sclk <= 1'b0;
            cs <= 1'b1; // Active low

                cs <= 1'b0; // Start transmission
                sending <= 1'b1;
                bit_count <= 3'b0;
                done <= 1'b0;
            end else if (sending) begin
                if (bit_count < 3'd8) begin
                    if (cpha) begin
                        sclk <= ~sclk; // Toggle clock
                        if (sclk) begin
                            mosi <= shift_reg[7 - bit_count]; // Send bit
                            bit_count <= bit_count + 1'b1;

                        end
                    end
                end else begin
                    done <= 1'b1; // Transmission complete
                    cs <= 1'b1; // End transmission
                    sending <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    input wire [7:0] data_in,  // Data to send to slave
    input wire start,          // Start signal to begin transmission
    output reg mosi,          // Master Out Slave In
    output reg sclk,          // SPI Clock
    output reg cs_n,          // Chip Select (active low)
    output reg [7:0] data_out, // Data received from slave
    output reg done           // Transmission done flag
);

    reg [3:0] bit_cnt;          // Bit counter
    reg [7:0] shift_reg;        // Shift register for data

    // State encoding
    localparam IDLE = 3'b000,
               START = 3'b001,
               TRANSFER = 3'b010,
               DONE = 3'b011;

    // SCLK generation
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            sclk <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            sclk <= ~sclk;
        end
    end

    // State machine
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            cs_n <= 1'b1; // Chip select high (inactive)
            done <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (start) begin
                        cs_n <= 1'b0; // Activate chip select
                        shift_reg <= data_in; // Load data to send
                        bit_cnt <= 4'b0; // Initialize bit counter

                    done <= 1'b1; // Set done flag
                    state <= IDLE; // Return to idle

            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
